# P0-04 — Python hygiene

Status: **OPEN-WITH-GAP**. Everything the ticket lists is done. One frozen physics test still fails, as it does on all three baselines; the frozen tree can only change through P1-12, and the physics fix is P1-03.

## Changes
- `uv.lock` committed (538 packages, `uv lock --check` clean). The workspace root declares `[tool.uv.sources]` `{ workspace = true }` for all 12 members. Before this, `uv sync` failed with "missing an entry in `tool.uv.sources`".
- `[tool.uv] dev-dependencies` → `[dependency-groups].dev`.
- `asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function"` added to every pytest config: root, backend, qcompass-core, qcompass-bench, qcompass-router (router lane), qfull-{amo,chemistry,condmat,gravity,hep,nuclear,statmech}. The `qcompass` meta-package has no pytest section.
- Every `datetime.utcnow()` is replaced with `datetime.now(UTC)` (qcompass-core manifest; qcompass-bench runner/registry/store/tests; qcompass-router calibration/budget, done in the router lane). `grep -rn 'utcnow()' backend packages` finds only the router's `_utcnow()` helper, which returns `datetime.now(UTC)`.
- Subprocess tests in `backend/tests/test_qcompass_adapter.py` use `sys.executable`. The freeze-hash test now uses dirhash's Python API with the same ignore set as the drift alarm.
- The backend + all plugins install from the lock in CI (`uv sync --frozen --all-packages --extra dev --extra qcompass --extra viz --group dev`) in both `ci-python.yml` jobs.
- qcompass-bench `0.1.0` → `0.2.0` (matches release-please manifest and the meta-package pin `>=0.2,<0.3`).
- Starlette 1.10 TestClient deprecation fixed with `httpx2`. No warning filters were added.
- `needs_pyscf` marker registered (it was producing PytestUnknownMarkWarning).
- Contract test corrected to main's fixtures with the new `qcompass_core.wire` models; see LEDGER → Corrected tests.
- The resolution conflicts and the two extras that can't be resolved are recorded in LEDGER (Decisions / Removals).

## Run (fresh env from the lock)
`UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=<venv> uv sync --frozen --all-packages --python 3.12 --extra dev --extra qcompass --extra viz --group dev`

| Suite | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cd backend && python -m pytest -q` (no CLI overrides) | 233 passed, 1 xfailed, **1 failed** (6 min 20 s) |
| packages | `python -m pytest packages -q --import-mode=importlib` | 329 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed (5 min) |

Skips are `importorskip` for optional heavy backends that aren't installed (e.g. `pyblock2`, `qiskit_addon_sqd`). The xfail is the V2 η_B xfail, which only P1-08 may remove.

## Gap
`audit/physics/test_parity_hypothesis.py::test_gb_to_zero_decoupling` fails with Hypothesis case `xi=0.0078125`:
`f0=0.6727340798362141 > f=0.6727334867801893` (difference 5.9e-7, tolerance 1e-9). It fails the same way on main, the agent branch and the router branch (BASELINE.md). The test is inside the frozen `backend/audit/physics/` (R5), and R4 forbids loosening or skipping it. The cause is the placeholder GB coupling in `pipeline.py`, which P1-03 replaces with physical couplings ("Done when: GB→0 decoupling … hold as strict property tests").

## A7 re-run on the merged tree (plan-author correction 2)
`backend/audit/agent/` is not frozen (only `audit/physics/` and `golden.lock` are). On merged `build/w0-consolidate` (router + viz lanes merged), with a fresh env from the lock:
`cd backend && python -m pytest audit/agent/test_a7_qcompass_routes.py -v -rs` → **11 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped** (2.0 s).
The viz lane reported 5 A7 failures (`KeyError: 'runId'`, 503s) in its own lane venv, but they don't reproduce on the merged tree. The full backend run above also includes `audit/agent` (A1–A9) with no failures. Nothing to fix.

## Gate 0 exception (plan-author correction 1)
Gate 0 may pass with exactly one pre-existing failure, `test_gb_to_zero_decoupling` (above). It must be green by Gate 1 (P1-03; otherwise P1-04/P1-07 fix it as a solver-precision defect).
